{"notes":"OPERATOR (Mark 2026-10-22): expect LF devops (kernel.org admins) to run the canonical instance, published by whoever hosts the registry repo; its URL is the one in the faq3.5 DID document. Docs must say: the bridge is optional (git vouch/patatt/b4 read the registry directly; it serves outside verifiers like OpenVTC verify-trust); canonical = LF devops via the DID document; anyone may run their own against a mirror (stateless, no credentials, public repo; same answers if the mirror is fresh, see faq3.6); or run it on localhost next to verify-trust. Ops burden: one Python process behind a TLS reverse proxy, periodic git fetch, no database, no secrets; the one duty is staying in sync. Write the deployment doc for kernel.org's setup, not generically.
SYSTEMD UNITS for the deployment doc (from vouch-faq3.6). Run as one user whose ~/.gitconfig has vouch.registry (git vouch setup --registry URL run once as that user). Bridge and timer must share User and XDG_DATA_HOME/HOME: the bridge gates on the copy git vouch query reads ($XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share, then git-vouch/registry). Hourly sync leaves 23 failed attempts before the 24h refusal.

# /etc/systemd/system/git-vouch-sync.service
[Unit]
Description=Sync the git-vouch registry copy
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=git-vouch
ExecStart=/usr/bin/git vouch sync

# /etc/systemd/system/git-vouch-sync.timer
[Unit]
Description=Sync the git-vouch registry copy hourly

[Timer]
OnBootSec=2min
OnUnitActiveSec=1h
RandomizedDelaySec=5min
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/git-vouch-trqp.service
[Unit]
Description=git-vouch TRQP bridge
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
User=git-vouch
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/git-vouch-trqp serve --did did:web:REGISTRY.example --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

Enable: systemctl enable --now git-vouch-sync.timer git-vouch-trqp.service. A failed sync shows in systemctl status git-vouch-sync / journalctl -u git-vouch-sync (exit 1, reason on stderr); the bridge then answers 503 unavailable (retryable) once the last good sync is 24h old."}
